title: Agent World Description
description: The environment an agent is exercised in: the rows that exist at t0, what the world is faithful about, and which of the agent's external systems it stands in for. Draft v0. A world CITES the agent's specification for entities, operations and policy, and may not declare them — see SPEC.md.

seed.description: Fixes everything random a run against this world does.

path.description: Where to find it. A locator, not the citation: a path that leads to a different id or version fails at load.

not_faithful_about.description: The more useful half. A world listing only its strengths invites assertions it cannot support.

verified_against.description: How the fidelity claim was checked. null means asserted, not tested.

projects.description: The agent specification's external system this one stands in for.

resolution.description: mock: answer from the world. replay: answer from a recording. real: call the real system. shadow: call the real one, serve the mock, diff the two — the mock-fidelity drift detector.

refusal.description: What the system says when a precondition fails. May name the entity's fields as {field}.

presents.description: How the stand-in presents each operation: the system's words, not the agent's.

records.description: The rows that exist at t0, by entity. Only entities the projected systems own.
